info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Model Production Risk Model-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of production risk models within the banking sector. By leveraging this API, financial institutions can create and update risk models that assess potential risks associated with various banking operations. Typical consumers include risk management teams and compliance departments looking to enhance their risk assessment capabilities. This API plays a critical role in ensuring informed decision-making and regulatory adherence by providing robust tools for model management.

post.summary: Create a new production risk model.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new production risk model by submitting the required data. The model will be added to the list of production risk models that can be used for evaluation and analysis.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating a new production risk model. The body must conform to the specified JSON schema, which defines the required structure and fields for the model.
